root_cause: The existing content growth learning materializer previously generated candidate scores and diagnoses but not a bounded hypothesis/holdout/readback contract, clear client-versus-market scope, counterfactual alternatives and Trusted Advisor decision rights. Incomplete GA4 and Search Console observations must not be mistaken for evidence of causal performance or client-level predictions.
fix: Within the existing daily content growth learning artifact add an explainable Lean Startup + Trusted Advisor decision projection: observed aggregate evidence, alternative explanations, hypotheses, pre-registered metrics, guardrails, source freshness, blocked expired research, customer control and use of existing Supabase experiment/forecast owners.
prevention_rule: No individual profile or tenant-specific claim from global marketing data; market signals are research not conversion outcomes. No numeric probability without canonical calibration. Only independently verified source and adequate sample may enter canonical bounded experiment review; winner promotion requires holdout, observed mature commercial outcomes, quality/security/consent gates and live readback. No second scheduler or learning store.
terminal_rule: Exact HEAD Required + CodeQL, protected merge and real daily learning artifact readback; this projection does not independently activate per-tenant advisors or experiments.
